verses.geez: እግዚኦ፡ አቡየ፡ አምላከ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ኢትግድፈኒ፡ በምክረ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ ወኢትኅድገኒ፡ እደቅ፡ ቦሙ።
verses.translation: O Lord, Father and Governor of my life, leave me not to their counsels, and let me not fall by them.

translations.lxx: O Lord, Father and Governor of my life, leave me not to their counsels, and let me not fall by them.
translations.ron: Doamne, Părintele şi Stăpânul vieţii mele, nu mă lăsa să mă ducă gura mea cum va vrea ea şi nu îngădui să alunec din pricina ei!
translations.grk: Κύριε πάτερ καὶ δέσποτα ζωῆς μου, μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με ἐν βουλῇ αὐτῶν, μὴ ἀφῇς με πεσεῖν ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይጌሥጾ፡ ሊተ፡ ለልብየ፡ ወመኑ፡ ይሜህራ፡ ሊተ፡ ጥበብ፡ ለኅሊናየ፡ ከመ፡ ይኅድገኒ፡ እበድየ፡ ወኢይማኡኒ፡ በዘይነቡ፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: Who will set scourges over my thoughts, and the discipline of wisdom over mine heart? that they spare me not for mine ignorances, and it pass not by my sins:

translations.lxx: Who will set scourges over my thoughts, and the discipline of wisdom over mine heart? that they spare me not for mine ignorances, and it pass not by my sins:
translations.ron: Cine va pune peste cugetul meu bătăi? Şi peste inima mea învăţătura înţelepciunii? Ca rătăcirile mele să nu fie cruţate şi să nu fie îngăduite păcatele?
translations.grk: Τίς ἐπιστήσει ἐπὶ τοῦ διανοήματός μου μάστιγας, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς καρδίας μου παιδείαν σοφίας; ἵνα ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀγνοήμασί μου μὴ φείσωνται, καὶ οὐ μὴ παρῇ τὰ ἁμαρτήματα αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ኢይብዝኀኒ፡ ጌጋይየ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢትፈድፍድ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይደቅ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለፀርየ፡ ወኢትፍሥሑ፡ ጸላእትየ፡ ዲቤየ።
verses.translation: lest mine ignorances increase, and my sins abound to my destruction, and I fall before mine adversaries, and mine enemy rejoice over me, whose hope is far from thy mercy.

translations.lxx: lest mine ignorances increase, and my sins abound to my destruction, and I fall before mine adversaries, and mine enemy rejoice over me, whose hope is far from thy mercy.
translations.ron: Ca greşelile mele să nu se înmulţească şi păcatele mele să nu sporească şi să nu cad în mâinile potrivnicilor mei şi să nu se bucure de aceasta vrăjmaşul meu?
translations.grk: ὅπως μὴ πληθύνωσιν αἱ ἄγνοιαί μου, καὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι μου πλεονάσωσιν, καὶ πεσοῦμαι ἔναντι τῶν ὑπεναντίων, καὶ ἐπιχαρεῖταί μοι ὁ ἐχθρός μου.

verses.geez: እግዚየ፡ ወአቡየ፡ ወአምላከ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ኢታምጽእ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘያስሕታ፡ ለዐይንየ።
verses.translation: O Lord, Father and God of my life, give me not a proud look.

translations.lxx: O Lord, Father and God of my life, give me not a proud look.
translations.ron: Doamne, Părintele şi Dumnezeul vieţii mele! Înălţarea ochilor nu-mi da, şi pofta întoarce-o de la mine.
translations.grk: Κύριε πάτερ καὶ Θεὲ ζωῆς μου, μετεωρισμὸν ὀφθαλμῶν μὴ δῷς μοι,

verses.geez: ወአሰስል፡ ፍትወተ፡ እምኔነ።
verses.translation: Turn away concupiscence from me.

translations.lxx: Turn away concupiscence from me.
translations.ron: Pofta pântecelui şi a împreunării trupului să nu mă cuprindă şi duhului celui fără de ruşine să nu mă dai.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν ἀπόστρεψον ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ.

verses.geez: ጽጋብ፡ ኢይምጽአኒ፡ ወፈሐል፡ ኢይክርየኒ፡ ወለነፍስ፡ እኪት፡ ኢትመጥወኒ።
verses.translation: Let not the greediness of the belly nor lust of the flesh take hold of me; and give me not over into an impudent mind.

translations.lxx: Let not the greediness of the belly nor lust of the flesh take hold of me; and give me not over into an impudent mind.
translations.ron: Învăţătura gurii auziţi, fiilor; pe aceasta cine o va păzi nu va cădea prins.
translations.grk: Κοιλίας ὄρεξις καὶ συνουσιασμὸς μὴ καταλαβέτωσάν με, καὶ ψυχῇ ἀναιδεῖ μὴ παραδῷς με. ΠΑΙΔΕΙΑ ΣΤΟΜΑΤΟΣ.

verses.geez: >ስምዑኒ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ ተግሣጸ፡ አፉየ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ዐቀበ፡ ኢይድኅፅ፡ ወዘአጽንዐ፡ ከናፍሪሁ።
verses.translation: Hear, O ye children, the discipline of the mouth: he that keepeth it shall never be taken in his lips.

translations.lxx: Hear, O ye children, the discipline of the mouth: he that keepeth it shall never be taken in his lips.
translations.ron: Din vorbele sale se va prinde păcătosul; ocărâtorul şi trufaşul vor pieri la fel.
translations.grk: Παιδείαν στόματος ἀκούσατε τέκνα, καὶ ὁ φυλάσσων οὐ μὴ ἁλῷ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ኃጥእ፡ ወዕቡይ፡ ወጸዓሊ፡ ይትዐቀፉ፡ ቦሙ።
verses.translation: The sinner shall be left in his foolishness: both the evil speaker and the proud shall fall thereby.

translations.lxx: The sinner shall be left in his foolishness: both the evil speaker and the proud shall fall thereby.
translations.ron: A jura nu-ţi învăţa gura şi a numi pe Cel Sfânt nu te obişnui.
translations.grk: Καταλειφθήσεται ἁμαρτωλὸς, καὶ λοίδορος καὶ ὑπερήφανος σκανδαλισθήσονται ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ኢታልምዶ፡ መሐላ፡ ለአፉከ፡ ወስሞ፡ ለቅዱስ፡ ኢትዝክር፡ ሶበ፡ ትምሕል።
verses.translation: Accustom not thy mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.

translations.lxx: Accustom not thy mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.
translations.ron: Că precum sluga, care adeseori se cercetează, multe bătăi ia, aşa şi cel care jură şi pururea numeşte pe Cel Sfânt, de păcat nu se va curăţi.
translations.grk: Ὅρκῳ μὴ ἐθίσῃς τὸ στόμα σου, καὶ ὀνομασίᾳ τοῦ ἁγίου μὴ συνεθισθῇς.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ገብር፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ጊዜ፡ የሐትትዎ፡ ኢይጸብእ፡ ቊስለ፡ ለሥጋሁ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዘይዜከር፡ ስሞ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘልፈ፡ እንዘ፡ ይምሕል፡ ኢይነጽሕ፡ እምነ፡ ኀጢአት።
verses.translation: For as a servant that is continually beaten shall not be without a blue mark: so he that sweareth and nameth God continually shall not be faultless.

translations.lxx: For as a servant that is continually beaten shall not be without a blue mark: so he that sweareth and nameth God continually shall not be faultless.
translations.ron: Bărbatul care jură mult se va umple de fărădelege şi nu se va depărta de casa lui biciul.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ γὰρ οἰκέτης ἐξεταζόμενος ἐνδελεχῶς ἀπὸ μώλωπος οὐκ ἐλαττωθήσεται, οὕτως ὁ καὶ ὀμνύων καὶ ὀνομάζων διαπαντὸς ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας οὐ μὴ καθαρισθῇ.

verses.geez: ብዙኅ፡ ጌጋዩ፡ ለብእሲ፡ መሓሊ፡ ወኢየኀልቅ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ቤቱ። ወእመኒ፡ ረስዐ፡ ኀጢአቱሰ፡ ኢይትኀደጎ፡ ወእመኒ፡ ተጸመመ፡ ካዕበተ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ጌጋዩ። ወኢይጸድቅ፡ በዘ፡ መሐለ፡ እስመ፡ ምሉእ፡ ፍዳሁ፡ ዲበ፡ ቤቱ።
verses.translation: A man that useth much swearing shall be filled with iniquity, and the plague shall never depart from his house: if he shall offend, his sin shall be upon him: and if he acknowledge not his sin, he maketh a double offence: and if he swear in vain, he shall not be innocent, but his house shall be full of calamities.

translations.lxx: A man that useth much swearing shall be filled with iniquity, and the plague shall never depart from his house: if he shall offend, his sin shall be upon him: and if he acknowledge not his sin, he maketh a double offence: and if he swear in vain, he shall not be innocent, but his house shall be full of calamities.
translations.ron: De va greşi, păcatul lui asupra lui va fi, şi de nu va fi cu luare aminte îndoit greşeşte.
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ πολύορκος πλησθήσεται ἀνομίας, καὶ οὐκ ἀποστήσεται ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ μάστιξ· ἐὰν πλημμελήσῃ, ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, κᾄν ὑπερίδῃ, ἥμαρτε δισσῶς· καὶ εἰ διακενῆς ὤμοσεν, οὐ δικαιωθήσεται, πλησθήσεται γὰρ ἐπαγωγῶν ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ቦቱ፡ ቃለ፡ እንተ፡ ታመጽኣ፡ ለሞት፡ ወኢትሄሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስተ፡ ያዕቆብ። ኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢሀለወ፡ ኀበ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኢይትዐቀፉ፡ በኀጢአት።
verses.translation: There is a word that is clothed about with death: God grant that it be not found in the heritage of Jacob; for all such things shall be far from the godly, and they shall not wallow in their sins.

translations.lxx: There is a word that is clothed about with death: God grant that it be not found in the heritage of Jacob; for all such things shall be far from the godly, and they shall not wallow in their sins.
translations.ron: Şi de a jurat în deşert, nu se va îndrepta, că se va umple de rele casa lui.
translations.grk: Ἔστι λέξις ἀντιπεριβεβλημένη θανάτῳ, μὴ εὑρεθήτω ἐν κληρονομίᾳ Ἰακώβ· ἀπὸ γὰρ εὐσεβῶν ταῦτα πάντα ἀποστήσεται, καὶ ἐν ἁμαρτίαις οὐκ ἐγκυλισθήσονται.

verses.geez: ነገረ፡ ስላቅ፡ ኢይፃእ፡ እምአፉከ፡ እስመቦ፡ ውስቴቱኒ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ኀጢአት።
verses.translation: Use not thy mouth to intemperate swearing, for therein is the word of sin.

translations.lxx: Use not thy mouth to intemperate swearing, for therein is the word of sin.
translations.ron: Este grai care este deopotrivă cu moartea; să nu se afle acesta întru moştenirea lui Iacov.
translations.grk: Ἀπαιδευσίαν ἀσυρῆ μὴ συνεθίσῃς τὸ στόμα σου, ἔστι γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ λόγος ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ተዘከሮሙ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ወለእምከ፡ ወተፀመድ፡ መኳንንቲከ፡ ወኢትስሐት፡ በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወኢትልሳሕ፡ በእበድከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትበል፡ ሶበ፡ ኢተወለድኩ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢትርግም፡ ዕለተ፡ ተወለድከ።
verses.translation: Remember thy father and thy mother, when thou sittest among great men. Be not forgetful before them, and so thou by thy custom become a fool, and wish that thou hadst not been born, and curse the day of thy nativity.

translations.lxx: Remember thy father and thy mother, when thou sittest among great men. Be not forgetful before them, and so thou by thy custom become a fool, and wish that thou hadst not been born, and curse the day of thy nativity.
translations.ron: Că de la cei binecredincioşi toate acestea se vor depărta şi în păcate ei nu se vor tăvăli.
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι πατρὸς καὶ μητρός σου, ἀναμέσον γὰρ μεγιστάνων συνεδρεύεις· μήποτʼ ἐπιλάθῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν, καὶ τῷ ἐθισμῷ σου μωρανθῇς, καὶ θελήσεις εἰ μὴ ἐγεννήθης, καὶ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ τοκετοῦ σου καταράσῃ.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ዘልሙድ፡ ስላቀ፡ ኢይጠብብ፡ አምጣነ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: The man that is accustomed to opprobrious words will never be reformed all the days of his life.

translations.lxx: The man that is accustomed to opprobrious words will never be reformed all the days of his life.
translations.ron: Cu vorba cea fără de cumpătare nu-ţi obişnui gura, că întru aceea este cuvântul păcatului.
translations.grk: Ἄνθρωπος συνεθιζόμενος λόγοις ὀνειδισμοῦ, ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ παιδευθῇ.

verses.geez: ክልኤቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ ያመጽእዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ ወሣልሶሙ፡ ያመጽኣ፡ ለመንሱት፡ ነፍስ፡ መዐትም፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ ወኢትቈርር፡ እስከ፡ ታሰጥሞ፡ ወብእሲኒ፡ ዘይዜሙ፡ በነፍስተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ኢኀድግ፡ እስከ፡ ያነድዳ፡ ለእሳት።
verses.translation: Two sorts of men multiply sin, and the third will bring wrath: a hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he hath kindled a fire.

translations.lxx: Two sorts of men multiply sin, and the third will bring wrath: a hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he hath kindled a fire.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte de tatăl tău şi de mama ta, când şezi în mijlocul celor mari,
translations.grk: Δύο εἴδη πληθύνουσιν ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ἐπάξει ὀργήν· ψυχὴ θερμὴ ὡς πῦρ καιόμενον, οὐ μὴ σβεσθῆ ἕως ἂν καταποθῇ· ἄνθρωπος πόρνος ἐν σώματι σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ παύσηται ἕως ἂν ἐκκαύσῃ πῦρ.

verses.geez: ለብእሲ፡ ዘማዊ፡ ኵሉ፡ እክል፡ ይጥዕሞ፡ ወኢያዐርፍ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይመውት።
verses.translation: All bread is sweet to a whoremonger, he will not leave off till he die.

translations.lxx: All bread is sweet to a whoremonger, he will not leave off till he die.
translations.ron: Ca nu cumva să uiţi de tine în fala lor, casă nu te porţi ca un prost,
translations.grk: Ἀνθρώπῳ πόρνῳ πᾶς ἄρτος ἡδὺς, οὐ μὴ κοπάσῃ ἕως ἂν τελευτήσῃ.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ዘይትፋለስ፡ እምነ፡ ምስካቢሁ፡ ወይብል፡ በልቡ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይሬእየኒ፡ ጽልመት፡ ብሔር፡ ወአረፍትኒ፡ ይሴውረኒ፡ ምንተ፡ እፈርህ፡ እንከ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያአምረኒ፡ ወልዑልኒ፡ ይረስዕ፡(ሊተ፡)፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ ወኢይዜከረኒ።
verses.translation: A man that breaketh wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the most High will not remember my sins:

translations.lxx: A man that breaketh wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the most High will not remember my sins:
translations.ron: Aşa încât să vrei să nu te fi născut şi să-ţi blestemi ziua naşterii tale.
translations.grk: Ἄνθρωπος παραβαίνων ἀπὸ τῆς κλίνης αὐτοῦ, λέγων ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ, τίς μὲ ὁρᾷ; σκότος κύκλῳ μου, καὶ οἱ τοῖχοί με καλύπτουσι, καὶ οὐθείς με ὁρᾷ, τί εὐλαβοῦμαι; τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου οὐ μὴ μνησθήσεται ὁ ὕψιστος·

verses.geez: ወዳእሙ፡ ዐይነ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ኢይርአዮ፡ ወኢያአምር፡ ከመ፡ ዐይነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይበርህ፡ እምአእላፈ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወይሬእዮ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምግባሮ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወያአምሮ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ጽምሚተ።
verses.translation: such a man only feareth the eyes of men, and knoweth not that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.

translations.lxx: such a man only feareth the eyes of men, and knoweth not that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.
translations.ron: Omul care se obişnuieşte cu cuvinte de sudalmă, în toate zilele sale, nu se va înţelepţi.
translations.grk: καὶ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἀνθρώπων ὁ φόβος αὐτοῦ· καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου μυριοπλασίως ἡλίου φωτεινότεροι, ἐπιβλέποντες πάσας ὁδοὺς ἀνθρώπων, καὶ κατανοοῦντες εἰς ἀπόκρυφα μέρη.

verses.geez: ወበማእከለ፡ ሀገር፡ ይትቤቀሎ፡ ወእንተ፡ ኀበ፡ ኢተሐዘበ፡ ያሠግሮ።
verses.translation: This man shall be punished in the streets of the city, and where he suspecteth not he shall be taken.

translations.lxx: This man shall be punished in the streets of the city, and where he suspecteth not he shall be taken.
translations.ron: Sufletul fierbinte ca focul arzător, care nu se stinge până ce nu se potoleşte;
translations.grk: Οὗτος ἐν πλατείαις πόλεως ἐκδικηθήσεται, καὶ οὗ οὐχ ὑπενόησε πιασθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወከማሁ፡ ብእሲትኒ፡ እንተ፡ ተኀድግ፡ ምታ፡ ወትውልድ፡ ወራሴ፡ በዲበ፡ መሐዛ።
verses.translation: Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and bringeth in an heir by another.

translations.lxx: Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and bringeth in an heir by another.
translations.ron: Omul care pofteşte în trupul cărnii sale şi nu va înceta, până nu va aţâţa foc;
translations.grk: Οὕτως καὶ γυνὴ καταλιποῦσα τὸν ἄνδρα, καὶ παριστῶσα κληρονόμον ἐξ ἀλλοτρίου.

verses.geez: አሐቲ፡ ክሕደት፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ ወካልእታ፡ ዐለወቶ፡>ለምታ፤ ወሣልስታ፡ ሰረቀት፡ በዝሙታ፡ ወአቀመት፡ ውሉደ፡ እምላዕለ፡ መሐዛ።
verses.translation: For first, she hath disobeyed the law of the most High; and secondly, she hath trespassed against her own husband; and thirdly, she hath played the whore in adultery, and brought children by another man.

translations.lxx: For first, she hath disobeyed the law of the most High; and secondly, she hath trespassed against her own husband; and thirdly, she hath played the whore in adultery, and brought children by another man.
translations.ron: Pentru desfrânat toată pâinea este dulce, nu va înceta până la sfârşit.
translations.grk: Πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ ἐν νόμῳ ὑψίστου ἠπείθησε, καὶ δεύτερον εἰς ἄνδρα ἑαυτῆς ἐπλημμέλησε, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ἐν πορνείᾳ ἐμοιχεύθη, ἐξ ἀλλοτρίου ἀνδρὸς τέκνα παρέστησεν.

verses.geez: ለእንተ፡ ከመዝ፡ የኀስርዋ፡ ወትትቀሠፍ፡ በውሉዳ።
verses.translation: She shall be brought out into the congregation, and inquisition shall be made of her children.

translations.lxx: She shall be brought out into the congregation, and inquisition shall be made of her children.
translations.ron: Omul care păcătuieşte în patul său şi zice în inima sa: Cine mă vede?
translations.grk: Αὕτη εἰς ἐκκλησίαν ἐξαχθήσεται, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἐπισκοπὴ ἔσται.

verses.geez: ወይሤረው፡ ዘርኣ፡ ወፍሬሃ፡ ወኢይፈርዩ፡ አዕጹቂሃ።
verses.translation: Her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit.

translations.lxx: Her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit.
translations.ron: Întuneric este împrejurul meu, pereţii mă acoperă şi nimeni nu mă vede, pentru ce mă sfiesc?
translations.grk: Οὐ διαδώσουσι τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς εἰς ῥίζαν, καὶ οἱ κλάδοι αὐτῆς οὐ δώσουσι καρπόν.

verses.geez: ወርጉመ፡ ይከውን፡ ዝክራ፡ ወታወርስ፡ መርገመ፡ ለቤታ፡ ወኢየኀልቅ፡ ለዝላፉ፡(መርገማ፡ወ)ኀሳራ።
verses.translation: She shall leave her memory to be cursed, and her reproach shall not be blotted out.

translations.lxx: She shall leave her memory to be cursed, and her reproach shall not be blotted out.
translations.ron: Păcatele mele nu le va pomeni Cel Preaînalt. Astfel el se teme numai de ochii oamenilor.
translations.grk: Καταλείψει εἰς κατάραν τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ ὄνειδος αὐτῆς οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወያአምር፡ እንከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘርእያ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይኄይስ፡ እምፈሪሃ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይጥዕም፡ እምነ፡ ዐቂበ፡ ትእዛዙ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And they that remain shall know that there is nothing better than the fear of the Lord, and that there is nothing sweeter than to take heed unto the commandments of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And they that remain shall know that there is nothing better than the fear of the Lord, and that there is nothing sweeter than to take heed unto the commandments of the Lord.
translations.ron: Şi nu ştie că ochii Domnului de zece mii de ori sunt mai luminoşi decât soarele şi privesc la toate căile oamenilor şi văd toate părţile cele ascunse.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται οἱ καταλειφθέντες, ὅτι οὐθὲν κρεῖττον φόβου Κυρίου, καὶ οὐθὲν γλυκύτερον τοῦ προσέχειν ἐντολαῖς Κυρίου. ΑΙΝΕΣΙΣ ΣΟΦΙΑΣ.
